create.name: Aleya Dao
create.bio:
Aleya Dao is a sound healer and spiritual guide who lives on ten acres in the Sierra Nevada foothills of Central California, a little south of Yosemite. After studying at Lewis and Clark she trained in Oriental medicine in Santa Fe, then practised for several years in Telluride and later in Santa Barbara. Her teaching dates from 2001, when an experience on a sound table during a session changed how she perceived the world; she describes a lasting awareness of other realms and of angelic voices from that point on.

Her method is the subject of Seven Cups of Consciousness, a New World Library title and since translated into three further languages, which offers seven principles for working with the higher self and the energy fields around a person. Much of her work reaches people through Cups of Consciousness, a library of more than two thousand short guided audio meditations sent out by subscription, alongside live online group sessions every three weeks, an Empowered Empath course and recorded master classes. She sings and tones on nine sound healing albums, sees clients one to one, trains practitioners in her method over two years, and in spring hosts small private retreats on her land, with sessions in a sun room of crystal bowls.

books.title: Seven Cups of Consciousness: Change Your Life by Connecting to the Higher Realms
books.author: Aleya Dao
books.description: Her book lays out seven principles for working with the higher self and with the energy fields that she sees as shaping daily life. It mixes personal stories with step-by-step practices that readers can try on their own.

courses.title: Cups of Consciousness Daily Meditations
courses.description: A subscription that sends three or five short guided audio meditations a week by email, with sound and toning woven in. A higher tier adds her live online group sessions, and a yearly option opens the full archive of past recordings.
courses.price: $15.00 USD / mo (daily); $30.00 USD / mo (with TALL Cups); $900.00 USD (1 year plus archive)

courses.title: TALL Cups of Consciousness Live Sessions
courses.description: An hour-long live energy balancing session on video call, held every three weeks and recorded for those who listen later. She guides the group into a deep meditative state and works with their energy fields.

courses.title: The Empowered Empath Course
courses.description: A recorded course of about seven hours for people who feel other people's emotions strongly. It teaches practices and concepts for clearing what they pick up and for working with that sensitivity.

courses.title: Private Sessions with Aleya
courses.description: One-to-one sessions in which she tunes into a client's energy fields and passes information to their higher self, framing the client as the one who makes the change. Sessions are booked through her booking page.

courses.title: Private Retreat on the Land
courses.description: Three nights on her ten acres in the Central California foothills, open from February to May to a single guest or to groups of no more than four. It includes two in-person sessions of two hours, with calls by phone or Zoom before and after the stay.

courses.title: Deep Energetic Dive Intensives (recordings)
courses.description: Video and audio downloads of her past Deep Dive intensives. They can be watched or listened to at home in place of the live retreat.

free_resources.title: Free Cups of Consciousness Meditations
free_resources.description: A free page of over 75 of her audio meditations, together with her Conscious Conversations videos. Access is given after entering an email address.

free_resources.title: Cups of Consciousness Podcast
free_resources.description: Her free podcast, linked from her events page, with talks and conversations on her work with the higher realms.
